8 vouchers, social security disability vouchers, and veterans vouchers.
fields.note: Discrimination in renting based on rental assistance is stated, as are the voucher types and the example. Complaints go to the commission ("file a complaint" with "our office", Fair Housing and Equity). The name "Office of Fair Housing and Equity" is slightly paraphrased from "Fair Housing and Equity".
